cd /workspace/project && timeout 400 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,subprocess,time
OB=subprocess.check_output("grep -oE 'sk-obs1_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' ob_ready.txt | head -1",shell=True,text=True).strip()
M="deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated:thinking"
def bal():
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/get_user_balance",headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=30) as x: return json.load(x)['balance']
print(f"saldo sebelum: ${bal()}")
for mt in [400,1000,2000,4000]:
    b=json.dumps({"model":M,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Apa ibukota Indonesia? Jawab singkat."}],"max_tokens":mt}).encode()
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions",data=b,
      headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
    t0=time.time()
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=240) as x: d=json.load(x)
    el=time.time()-t0; u=d['usage']; msg=d['choices'][0]['message']
    rl=len((msg.get('reasoning_content') or msg.get('reasoning') or ''))
    c=(msg.get('content') or '').strip()
    print(f"max_tokens={mt:5} waktu={el:5.1f}s compl={u['completion_tokens']:4} reasoning={rl:4} content={'ADA' if c else 'KOSONG':7} cost=${u['cost']:.6f}  {c[:40]!r}")
PY
